groups.canonical_value: Prefer the return flight to depart in the afternoon.
groups.merge_rationale: This is specifically a return-leg afternoon departure preference and remains distinct from a general flexible-timing preference that also includes evening departures.

groups.canonical_value: Prefer flight departures in the afternoon or evening when timing is flexible.
groups.merge_rationale: This applies generally when departure timing is flexible and includes both afternoon and evening options, so it is not semantically equivalent to the return-leg afternoon-only preference.
